name: drowse-webui
description: Svelte+Vite source for the drowse analytics dashboard. `npm run build` emits to ../drowse/web/dist/.

scripts.test:lifecycles: node ./scripts/frame-queue.test.mjs && node ./scripts/probe-lifecycle.test.mjs && node ./scripts/readout-lifecycle.test.mjs && node ./scripts/manifold-progress.test.mjs && node ./scripts/appearance-lifecycle.test.mjs && node ./scripts/http-runtime-lifecycle.test.mjs
